a_attn_offu_L16.pt.INVALID.position_weighting: uniform mean over generated positions, then over sequences
a_attn_offu_L16.pt.INVALID.normalization: unit norm after orthogonalising against u
a_attn_offu_L16.pt.INVALID.stored_sign_convention: sign of the raw FT-minus-base attention write; NOT gauge-flipped
a_attn_offu_L16.pt.INVALID.INVALID: built from the o_proj INPUT and projected onto u, a RESIDUAL-space direction. The o_proj input is 3584-d so the arithmetic ran, but the two spaces are related by a learned linear map, not identity. Moved to fits/archive_invalid/. Do not resurrect without re-deriving from the attention OUTPUT (o_proj applied).
